name: Hagri
title: Father of one of David's mighty men
summary: Hagri is a person mentioned in the Bible primarily as the father of Mibhar, one of King David's powerful warriors. He is also associated with the Hagrites, a people whom the Israelites fought against. His name appears in genealogies and lists of David's mighty men in the Books of Chronicles.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned as father of Mibhar
keyEvents.description: Hagri is mentioned as the father of Mibhar, one of David's thirty mighty warriors who served the king faithfully.

keyEvents.title: The Hagrites in the genealogy
keyEvents.description: The Hagrites, a people linked to the name Hagar, are mentioned in connection with the tribes living east of the Jordan. The tribe of Reuben fought against them.

keyEvents.title: War against the Hagrites during Saul's reign
keyEvents.description: During King Saul's time, the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and half of Manasseh waged war against the Hagrites and defeated them, taking over their land.

keyEvents.title: The Hagrites were defeated
keyEvents.description: The Hagrites and their allies fell in battle because the Israelites cried out to God during the conflict, and He heard their prayer and gave them victory.

keyEvents.title: The Hagarites as Enemies of Israel
keyEvents.description: In the Book of Psalms, the Hagarites are mentioned among the nations that made a covenant against God's people and sought to destroy Israel.
